title: sciMAP-ATAC Protocol for Nuclei Isolation and Library Preparation
author: Andrew Adey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.brhxm37n
materials: Prepare tagmentation plate Add the following reagents to diluted nuclei in 96-well plate(s) (DNA and Protein Lo-bind): Prepare 70 μM Pitstop 2 + 2X TD buffer Master Mix for one plate: 28 μL 3mM Pitstop2 + 1,200 μL 2X TD Add 10 µL, 70uM Pitstop 2/TD buffer (2X) to each well Add 1 µL, 8uM uniquely indexed transposase to each well Spin down plate for 00:01:00, min at 500 rcf at 4 °C Tagmentation can be performed by the addition of 1 µL of 2.5 µM barcoded transposome (EZ-Tn5 variant) (Amini et al. 2014)
Transposase Denaturation Denature remaining transposase in sorted nuclei using SDS mixture on Eppendorf Thermocyclers. 55 °C for 00:20:00, min
Prepare Reagents Prepare 50 mL, 2.125X Tn5 Dilution buffer for protein dilution.

Anneal Oligo mixtures within a Thermocycler with the following reaction. 95 °C 00:05:00 Slow ramp down to 20 °C, at a rate of -2.5C/min 20 °C, hold This results in 16 micromolar (µM) annealed oligo species per reaction ( i7/ME' and i5/ME'). Oligoes should be freshly annealed prior to loading Tn5 transposome

Anneal Oligo mixtures within a Thermocycler with the following reaction. 95 °C 00:05:00 Slow ramp down to 20 °C, at a rate of -2.5C/min 20 °C, hold This results in 16 micromolar (µM) annealed oligo species per reaction ( i7/ME' and i5/ME'). Oligoes should be freshly annealed prior to loading Tn5 transposome

steps.title: Construct Nuclei Isolation Buffer (NIB)
steps.instruction: Prepare 50mL of Nuclei Isolation Buffer (NIB) using the specified stock concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 uL 1M Tris HCl, pH 7.5 (final 10 mM)
Add 100 uL 5M NaCl (final 10 mM)
Add 150 uL 1M MgCl2 (final 3mM)
Add 500 uL 10% Igepal (final 0.1 %)
Add 500 uL 10% Tween (final 0.1 %)
Fill to 50 mL with ddH2O
Optional: Add 2 tablets of Pierce Protease Inhibitor Tablets (EDTA-Free) and vortex to dissolve
Store NIB at 4 °C (stable for 1 month); keep on ice during dissociation and tagmentation plate preparation

steps.title: Prepare Microbiopsy Punch Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare 96-well plates for the collection of microbiopsy punches.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 100 uL NIB into each well (number of wells should match number of punches)
Seal plate and store on ice

steps.title: Collect Microbiopsies
steps.instruction: Collect tissue punches in a cryostat at -20°C.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cryopreserved tissue sections from -80°C to dry ice in an insulated container
Load Palkovitz punch handle with selected diameter (250 um, 500 um, 750 um, 1 mm, or 1.25 mm) and prechill in dry ice
Place tissue cryosection slide in cryostat and allow ~1 min to acclimate
Locate region of interest and collect punch
Deposit punch into a well of the 96-well plate by depressing the plunger
Repeat for each region, placing each new punch in a new well
Reseal plate and maintain a record of slide number, punch location, and well ID

steps.title: Dissociate and Wash Microbiopsies
steps.instruction: Dissociate the collected punches to isolate nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Shake plate on ice for 1 hour at 80 rpm
Triturate each well 30x using a multi-channel pipettor (pipette gently to avoid bubbles and shearing)
Spin down plate for 10 min at 500 rcf at 4°C
Aspirate 90 uL of supernatant from each well using a multi-channel pipettor, avoiding the bottom sides

steps.title: Dilute Nuclei and Add Pitstop 2
steps.instruction: Resuspend and dilute nuclei to a target concentration using a Pitstop 2 NIB master mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 70 uM Pitstop 2 NIB master mix (for 120 wells: combine 168 uL 3 mM Pitstop 2 and 3,432 uL NIB)
Add 30 uL of the 70 uM Pitstop 2 NIB master mix to each well
Triturate to resuspend cells

steps.title: Split Nuclei into Plates
steps.instruction: Distribute the resuspended nuclei into new plates.

substeps.instruction: Split 40 uL of resuspended cells from each original well into 4 new 96-well DNA/protein Lo-bind plates (10 uL diluted cells per well)
Ensure well IDs remain consistent across plates
Seal plate and incubate at 55 °C with gentle shaking (300 rpm on a thermomixer) for 15 minutes
Immediately place plate on ice to stop the reaction and prevent over-transposition or lysis

steps.title: Pool and Prepare for Second Sort
steps.instruction: Pool tagmented nuclei and prepare for the second round of flow sorting.

substeps.instruction: Pool all wells into a 15mL conical tube on ice
Add DAPI (5mg/mL) at a concentration of 2uL per mL of pooled sample
Prepare a second 96-well plate by adding 2.5 uL of 10 uM i5 Indexed PCR Primer and 2.5 uL of 10 uM i7 Indexed PCR Primer to each well (final volume 8.5uL/well of Transposase Neutralization Buffer)

steps.title: Flow Sort Single Nuclei
steps.instruction: Sort single nuclei into the prepared second plate.

substeps.instruction: Spin down plate at 500 rcf for 3 minutes at 4 °C
Sort X nuclei per well using 'Single cell' settings (e.g., 22 nuclei/well for 96 wells; 33 for 144 wells; 44 for 192 wells)
Keep sorted samples on ice to prevent transposase cross-reaction

steps.title: Amplify Single Cell Libraries
steps.instruction: Perform Nextera PCR amplification using a Bio-Rad CFX Connect.

substeps.instruction: Add 13.5 uL PCR Master Mix to each well. Use either:
Option A: 7.5 µL Master Mix, 0.25 µL 100X SYBR Green I, 5.5 µL dH2O
Option B (Kapa Hifi Non-Hotstart): 5 µL 5X Kapa Hifi Buffer (GC Buffer), 0.75 µL 10 mM Kapa dNTP Mix, 0.5 µL 1 U/uL Kapa Hifi DNA Polymerase, 0.25 µL 100X SYBR Green I, 6 µL dH2O
Run PCR and pull once the majority of wells begin to plateau (typically 14-22 cycles)
Store libraries at 4 °C (up to 6 months) or -20 °C

steps.title: Pool and Concentrate DNA
steps.instruction: Pool PCR products and purify using a column.

substeps.instruction: Pool 10 uL from each well into a 15mL conical tube
Run full pool volume through a Qiaquick PCR purification column per manufacturer's protocol
Elute in 50 µL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0

steps.title: Size Selection with SPRI Beads
steps.instruction: Perform 1X SPRI bead size selection for DNA > 200 bp.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL 18% PEG SPRI Beads (at room temperature) to column elution; incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes
Place on magnetic rack for ~2 minutes until elution clears; remove elution
Resuspend bead pellet in 100 µL 80% ethanol (v/v); remove ethanol
Air dry beads for ~8 minutes until cracks form
Resuspend beads off rack in 31 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0; incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes
Place on magnetic rack for ~20 minutes until elution clears; remove elution to a clean tube

steps.title: Quantify and Analyze DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA concentration and check quality.

substeps.instruction: Quantify 1uL of eluted sample using Qubit DNA High-sensitivity kit
Dilute sample to 4 ng/uL using 10mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 based on Qubit readout
Run 1 uL sample on Agilent DNA HS Bioanalyzer

steps.title: Sequence Libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence libraries on a NextSeq 500 sequencer.

substeps.instruction: Load libraries within a range of 1.2-1.6 pM using NextSeq500 NCS (v4.0) software
Use custom sequencing chemistry: Read 1 (50 cycles), Index Read 1 (8 imaged, 27 dark, 10 imaged), Index Read 2 (8 imaged, 21 dark, 10 imaged), Read 2 (50 cycles)
Use custom sequencing primers (Read1, Read2, Index1, and Index2 sequences as specified in the protocol table)

steps.title: Prepare Oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Prepare high-purity oligonucleotides for Tn5 loading.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Mosaic End reverse compliment (ME'), i7, and i5 oligonucleotides at 100 µM in Tris-HCl buffer (pH 8.0)
Ensure HPLC purification is used

steps.title: Anneal Indexed Oligos to ME'
steps.instruction: Create dsDNA by annealing indexed oligos to the Mosaic End reverse compliment.

substeps.instruction: For each i5 barcoded oligo (8 total): Combine 12.5 uL 100 uM i5 Tn5 Indexed oligo, 12.5 uL 100 uM ME' oligo, and 53.125 uL 2.125x Tn5 Dilution Buffer
For each i7 barcoded oligo (12 total): Perform similar annealing reaction

steps.title: Plate Annealed Oligos
steps.instruction: Load annealed oligos into a 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of i5/ME' (16 µM) to wells in a row-wise fashion
Add 5 µL of i7/ME' (16 µM) to wells in a column-wise fashion (final concentration 8 µM/well)

steps.title: Load and Assemble Tn5
steps.instruction: Adjust salt concentration of Tn5 protein and assemble the Tn5/oligo mixture.

substeps.instruction: Adjust Tn5 protein NaCl concentration to a final concentration of 555.55 mM (Combine 1152 uL and 144 uL components as specified)
Add 12 µL of salt-corrected Tn5 to each well of the 96-well plate
Incubate at 25 °C for 1 hour to assemble the Tn5/oligo mixture
Store at -20°C for no more than 8 months
